status.description: implemented: the approved plan is in the working tree (any listed test you could not write is in tests as not-written) and the checks pass. blocked: you stopped; explain why in summary.

summary.description: What you changed and why, for the pull request description (or why you are blocked).

changes.description: One entry per file you changed.

tests.description: One entry per test in the approved test list, by its ID, plus any other test you added or changed (with an empty id). On a fix, only the tests you added, changed, removed or could not write.

id.description: The ID from the approved test list, for example D1 (for a removed test, the ID of the listed test that replaces it). Empty for a test that is not on the list.

status.description: written: a new test. updated: an existing test changed. removed: a test the plan replaces, deleted. not-written: you could not write it; say why in note.

file.description: The test file, relative to the repository root. Always set, except when not-written.

name.description: The exact name of the test as it appears in the file. Always set, except when not-written.

note.description: Why, when not-written; otherwise anything a reviewer should know. Empty when there is nothing.

followUps.description: Anything deliberately left out of this change.

commit.description: The Conventional Commits header for the commit and the pull request title: type(scope)!: summary.

type.description: feat: new capability. fix: bug fix. refactor: no behaviour change. perf: performance. test: tests only. docs: docs only. ci: CI workflows. chore: maintenance and tooling.

scope.description: The area changed, lowercase, for example api, android, db, infra, tasks.

summary.description: Short imperative summary, lowercase start, no trailing period, for example add optional due dates to tasks.

breaking.description: True when the change breaks existing callers, data or behaviour (adds ! to the header).

breakingChange.description: When breaking: what breaks and what to do about it (the BREAKING CHANGE footer). Empty otherwise.
